annotations.title: Read or change what Google may make from the creative (text on videos, video cuts, written text)

description: What Google Ads is allowed to generate from the user’s own creative: text laid over videos (OVERLAY_TEXT_ON_VIDEOS), vertical and shorter video cuts, generated videos and animated images, image crops and enhancements, written headlines and landing-page text. Pass campaignId for campaign-level automation (Performance Max, Search), or adGroupId + adId for one ad: a Demand Gen video ad keeps OVERLAY_TEXT_ON_VIDEOS, GENERATE_VERTICAL_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS and GENERATE_SHORTER_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS there, and Google turns them ON by default. With no settings it READS what is set. settings is {TYPE: true|false}; a type you do not name keeps its current value, and one that was never set follows Google’s default. Turning a type OFF needs nothing more; turning one ON for something live needs confirm:true, because Google then serves versions it generated. The reply is what Google stored, read back. Free.

adGroupId.description: ad group id of the ad (with adId)

adId.description: ad id (google_ads_report FROM ad_group_ad lists ad_group.id and ad_group_ad.ad.id)

campaignId.description: campaign id, for campaign-level automation; or pass adGroupId + adId for one ad

confirm.description: true to turn an automation ON for a campaign or ad that is live

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and change nothing

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

settings.description: {TYPE: true to opt in, false to opt out}. Types: TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION, GENERATE_VERTICAL_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS, GENERATE_SHORTER_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS, GENERATE_LANDING_PAGE_PREVIEW, GENERATE_LANDING_PAGE_TEXT, GENERATE_ENHANCED_YOUTUBE_VIDEOS, GENERATE_IMAGE_ENHANCEMENT, GENERATE_IMAGE_EXTRACTION, GENERATE_DESIGN_VERSIONS_FOR_IMAGES, FINAL_URL_EXPANSION_TEXT_ASSET_AUTOMATION, GENERATE_VIDEOS_FROM_OTHER_ASSETS, GENERATE_ANIMATED_IMAGES_FROM_OTHER_ASSETS, AUTOMATED_VIDEO_CRAWL, OVERLAY_TEXT_ON_VIDEOS. Omit to read.

videoCrawlSources.description: only with settings.AUTOMATED_VIDEO_CRAWL: where Google may find videos

platform.description: what kind of source the URL is

url.description: full http(s) URL Google may look for videos at
